questions.q: What real example of certification-name drift does this lesson describe?
options: "Salesforce Certified Administrator" is commonly used informally, while Trailhead's live catalog today lists the credential as "Salesforce Certified Platform Administrator"
Salesforce has eliminated all certification names and uses numbers only
Platform App Builder was renamed to Platform Administrator
Trailhead no longer lists any Administrator-track credential
questions.explain: The lesson names this specific, real example found while researching the course: the informal name versus Trailhead's current live listing as 'Platform Administrator.'

questions.q: According to this lesson, what does LTV Academy actually do with respect to Salesforce certifications?
options: It issues official Salesforce certifications directly to students who complete this course
It guarantees a passing score on any Salesforce exam
It prepares students for the skills and objectives behind the credentials, but does not issue certifications -- Salesforce does, through its own exam
It has no relationship to Salesforce certifications at all
questions.explain: The lesson states plainly that LTV Academy prepares students for the underlying skills and objectives but does not issue certifications itself.

questions.q: What is the first step in this lesson's verification checklist before registering for an exam?
options: Ask a classmate what they remember about the exam
Pay the registration fee first, then check requirements
Assume the requirements from this course are still accurate
Go directly to trailhead.salesforce.com/credentials, not a search result or third-party blog
questions.explain: The checklist's first step is going straight to Trailhead's own live credentials page rather than a secondary source.

questions.q: Why does the lesson recommend re-checking exam requirements again shortly before actually scheduling, even if checked a few months earlier?
options: Because Trailhead deletes old exam guides automatically after 30 days
Because Salesforce ships multiple releases a year, and exam content can shift with them
Because re-checking is required to keep a Trailhead account active
Because practice exams expire every month
questions.explain: The lesson explains that Salesforce's multiple annual releases can shift exam content, so a check from months earlier may already be stale.

questions.q: Why does the lesson say it deliberately avoids ending the certification chapter with a specific, memorized checklist of exam facts?
options: Because specific facts are illegal to publish
Because Salesforce certifications no longer have any fixed content
Because that confidence would become inaccurate the moment Salesforce updates the page the chapter was based on
Because quizzes are not allowed to reference specific facts
questions.explain: The lesson explains that ending on a habit of checking, rather than a snapshot of facts, is what keeps the chapter accurate over time.
